notes: All 14 categories and all 125 listings are retained in the order supplied by the official menu.
There are 110 distinct exact dish names; signature entries repeat some names from other categories.
Combined dish names and preparation choices are kept as supplied; they are not split into invented listings.
Photo files are byte-for-byte copies of the image URLs attached to the official listings. They have not been generated, retouched, resized, or re-encoded.
Some URLs supplied by the restaurant already contain crop or preview settings; these URLs are preserved.
For listings with multiple photos, photo numbers follow the source order and do not assert which preparation variant each image depicts.
10 distinct dish names, spanning 11 listings, have no photo on the official menu. A named text note represents each missing photo.
Source English and Chinese spellings are retained. Online prices are a snapshot and may change; they may differ from dine-in prices.
